parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
The distance between the Sun and the Earth is 1.5 × 10^{11} m. State this distance in Gm.
distance = Gm
parts.question_text_latex:
The distance between the Sun and the Earth is $1.5 \times 10^{11}\,\mathrm{m}$. State this distance in Gm.
$distance = Gm $

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The distance from the centre of the Earth to a satellite above the equator is 42.3 Mm. The
radius of the Earth is 6380 km.
A microwave signal is sent from a point on the Earth directly below the satellite.
Calculate the time taken for the microwave signal to travel to the satellite and back.
time = s

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
The speed v of a sound wave through a gas of density ρ and pressure P is given by
v =(CP)/(ρ )
where C is a constant.
Show that C has no unit.
parts.question_text_latex:
The speed v of a sound wave through a gas of density $\rho$ and pressure P is given by
$v =\frac{CP}{\rho }$
where C is a constant.
Show that C has no unit.

parts.label: (e)
parts.question_text:
A boat travels across a river in which the water is moving at a speed of 1.8 m s^{-1}.
The velocity vectors for the boat and the river water are shown to scale in Fig. 1.1.
In still water the speed of the boat is 3.0 m s^{-1}. The boat is directed at an angle of 60° to the
river bank.

A boat travels across a river in which the water is moving at a speed of 1.8 m $s^{-1}$.
The velocity vectors for the boat and the river water are shown to scale in Fig. 1.1.
In still water the speed of the boat is 3.0 m $s^{-1}$. The boat is directed at an angle of 60° to the
river bank.
